transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Daniel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Daniel. My broadband has been dropping out every half an hour since yesterday morning and I work from home, so it's honestly been a nightmare.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That sounds really disruptive, especially when you're working from home. I'm going to get to the bottom of it with you. Before I do, could I take your account PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's 4 4 1 8.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And can I confirm I'm speaking with Priyanka Desai?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Priyanka. So, just to make sure I've got it right: since yesterday morning your connection drops roughly every thirty minutes, and it's affecting your work. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When it drops, does the light on the front of the router change colour, or does it stay white?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It goes orange for a minute or two, then comes back white.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. And does it drop on every device at the same time, laptop and phone, or only on one of them?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything at once. The TV box too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That tells me it's the line rather than your devices. Have you changed anything around the router recently, a new extension lead, moved it, anything like that?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We did move it into the hallway on Sunday so it reaches upstairs better.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's helpful to know. Is it plugged straight into the main phone socket in the hallway, or into an extension socket?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Into a little socket on the skirting board. I think it's an extension.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's very likely the cause. Extension sockets often cause exactly this kind of dropping. Would you be able to plug the router into the main socket, the one where the line comes into the house, just while we test it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can, it's just by the front door. Give me a second.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's plugged in there now. The light is flashing white.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's it starting up. While it does that, I'm also going to run a check on the line from my side.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The line test is coming back clean, and I can see your router has just connected at full speed, which is a good sign.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's gone solid white now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. To be sure, could you load a couple of pages or start a video, and tell me whether it all comes up normally?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, a video is playing, and work email is syncing fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Brilliant. So the connection is back and stable on the main socket. If you need it in the hallway, I can send you a free wifi booster instead of using the extension socket. Would that be useful?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh yes, that would be great actually.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Lovely, I've ordered it and it will arrive in two to three working days. I'll also stay on the line notes as the owner of this case, so if the drops come back you can quote reference SN-55102 and it comes straight to me.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks, that's really helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Is the connection working well enough now for you to get on with your day?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's all working now. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, then we're all sorted. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Priyanka?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, and have a lovely rest of your day.
